services.desc: Gone Sailing Adventures was founded in 2008 by Howie Colt and started charters in 2010. Gone Sailing Adventures’ fleet includes 9 luxury yachts - 1 catamaran, 5 sailing & 3 motor. All our yachts exceed Transport Canada minimum safety requirements and include a licensed captain and host. Each boat is a brilliant example of modern ship engineering and boasts a superior interior finish. On our larger yachts, there is both covered (bimini) and open areas for those who cannot decide whether they want sun or shade. Choose one of our luxury yachts with a capacity of 2-12 guests or arrange multiple boats (up to 90 participants and 9 sailing yachts). Private Charters are perfect for couples, intimate groups, families, and friends.
